hypothesis: completeCartWorkflow never re-checks stock (confirmInventory runs only in add-to-cart/update-line-item/create-carts). Reservation in reserveInventoryStep (inventory-module createReservationItems_) only ensures a level exists and adds to reserved_quantity without an availability check, so when stock drops or two carts both pass an earlier check, completing both can oversell SOLO (stocked 1). I expect two SOLO carts each for 1 unit, both completed concurrently across two servers, to produce two orders needing 2 units against 1 stocked, failing no_oversell.
